sections.label: Shoes and ankles
sections.evidence: Two separate black footprints span x=6–11 and x=12–17 at y=0–1. Gray bricks #31 and #33 begin an ankle above one footprint.

sections.label: Trouser legs
sections.evidence: Dark gray bricks form two parallel upright masses at x=7–11 and x=12–16, z=10–15, through y=2–6.

sections.label: Shirt and left sleeve
sections.evidence: Blue bricks bridge the legs and fill the torso at y=7–12, z=10–16. The sleeve projects toward x=5–7; brown #206 and #209 begin the neck above it.

sections.label: Right sleeve and hand
sections.evidence: Blue bricks extend along x=15–18 beside the torso. Brown pieces at x=15–17, z=6–9 form the forward hand, with light gray #189 above it.

sections.label: Head and hair
sections.evidence: Brown bricks form the neck and head at y=13–17, with dark facial marks toward z=7–8. Black bricks cap the head at y=18–19; nearby yellow and gray pieces accompany the face.

sections.label: Plate of spaghetti
sections.evidence: White bricks form a broad dish at z=2–10, y=8–10. Yellow bricks fill its center, with red #159, #161 and #162 forming a topping at y=11.

sections.label: Face and hand details
sections.evidence: Brown and blue pieces complete the hand and sleeve near x=4–7. Brown #247 and #263 extend the head side; black #255 and #257 mark the eyes, with yellow pieces near the mouth.
